```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

```

## Read the data

```{r data}

data <- read.csv("Tables/Supplemental_Table_Metagenomics.txt", sep="\t")

```

## CPM calculation

```{r cpm, echo=FALSE}
processed <- data %>%
  filter(total_reads >= 1000000) %>%
  mutate(sir_species_cpm = reads_mapped_sir_species / total_reads * 1000000) %>%
  mutate(ismA_species_cpm = reads_mapped_ismA_species / total_reads * 1000000) %>%
  mutate(ismA_gene_cpm = reads_mapped_ismA_gene / total_reads * 1000000) %>%
  mutate(sir_gene_cpm = reads_mapped_sir_gene / total_reads * 1000000)

# Any sample with above 2 cpm for ismA/sir is considered an encoder of that gene
processed <- processed %>%
  mutate(ismA_Encoder = ifelse(ismA_gene_cpm >= 2, "Encoder", "Non-Encoder")) %>%
  mutate(sir_Encoder = ifelse(sir_gene_cpm >= 2, "Encoder", "Non-Encoder"))

```

## Plot results for PRISM

```{r plot}

library(patchwork)

PRISM_area_threshold <- 1e6

ismA_summary_prism <- processed %>%
  mutate(Converter = ifelse(area_coprostanol > PRISM_area_threshold, "Converter", "Non-Converter")) %>%
  filter(Study == "PRISM") %>%
  group_by(Converter, ismA_Encoder) %>%
  summarise(Count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Converter) %>%
  mutate(Percentage = (Count / sum(Count)) * 100)

sir_summary_prism <- processed %>%
  mutate(Converter = ifelse(area_coprostanol > PRISM_area_threshold, "Converter", "Non-Converter")) %>%
  filter(Study == "PRISM") %>%
  group_by(Converter, sir_Encoder) %>%
  summarise(Count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Converter) %>%
  mutate(Percentage = (Count / sum(Count)) * 100)

sir_summary_prism$sir_Encoder <- factor(sir_summary_prism$sir_Encoder, levels = c("Non-Encoder", "Encoder"))
ismA_summary_prism$ismA_Encoder <- factor(ismA_summary_prism$ismA_Encoder, levels = c("Non-Encoder", "Encoder"))

sir_summary_prism$Converter <- factor(sir_summary_prism$Converter, levels = c("Converter", "Non-Converter"), labels = c("Detected", "Undetected"))
ismA_summary_prism$Converter <- factor(ismA_summary_prism$Converter, levels = c("Converter", "Non-Converter"), labels = c("Detected", "Undetected"))

p1 <- ggplot(sir_summary_prism, aes(x = Converter, y = Count, fill = sir_Encoder)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Encoder" = "#ff7f00", "Non-Encoder" = "gray")) +  # Custom colors
  labs(title = "PRISM",
       x = "Fecal Coprostanol",
       xlabs = ("Detected, Undetected"),
       y = "Count") +
  theme_classic() +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(title = "ecSIR"))+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

p2 <- ggplot(ismA_summary_prism, aes(x = Converter, y = Count, fill = ismA_Encoder)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Encoder" = "#377eb8", "Non-Encoder" = "gray")) +  # Custom colors
  labs(
       x = "Fecal Coprostanol",
       xlabs = ("Detected, Undetected"),
       y = "Count") +
  theme_classic() +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(title = "ismA"))+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

prism <- p1 + p2

prism

```

```{r plot_func}

generate_violin_box_jitter_plot <- function(data, area_col, steroid_label, study) {
  ggplot(data, aes(x = sir_Encoder, y = log10(get(area_col) + 1), fill = sir_Encoder)) +
    geom_violin() +  # Create the violin plot
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("gray", "#ff7f00")) + 
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, color = "black", alpha = 0.2, outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(shape = 21, size = 1, fill="darkgray", stroke = 0.5, alpha = 0.5) +  # Add points with black outline
    theme_classic() +  # Use a minimal theme
    labs(title = study,
         x = "ecSIR encoder status",
         y = paste(steroid_label, " (log10 peak area)")) +  # Add titles and axis labels
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
}

ismA_generate_violin_box_jitter_plot <- function(data, area_col, steroid_label, study) {
  ggplot(data, aes(x = ismA_Encoder, y = log10(get(area_col) + 1), fill = ismA_Encoder)) +
    geom_violin() +  # Create the violin plot
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("gray", "#377eb8")) + 
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, color = "black", alpha = 0.2, outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(shape = 21, size = 1, fill="darkgray", stroke = 0.5, alpha = 0.5) +  # Add points with black outline
    theme_classic() +  # Use a minimal theme
    labs(
         x = "ecSIR encoder status",
         y = paste(steroid_label, " (log10 peak area)")) +  # Add titles and axis labels
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
}

```


```{r prism_levels}

prism_data <- processed %>%
  filter(Study == "PRISM")

prism_data$ismA_Encoder <- factor(prism_data$ismA_Encoder, levels = c("Non-Encoder", "Encoder"))

prism_data$sir_Encoder <- factor(prism_data$sir_Encoder, levels = c("Non-Encoder", "Encoder"))

coprostanol_prism <- generate_violin_box_jitter_plot(prism_data, "area_coprostanol","Stool Coprostanol", "PRISM")

cholesterol_prism <- generate_violin_box_jitter_plot(prism_data, "area_cholesterol", "Stool Cholesterol", "PRISM")

cholestenone_prism <- generate_violin_box_jitter_plot(prism_data, "area_cholestenone", "Stool Cholestenone", "PRISM")

ismA_coprostanol_prism <- ismA_generate_violin_box_jitter_plot(prism_data, "area_coprostanol","Stool Coprostanol", "PRISM")

ismA_cholesterol_prism <- ismA_generate_violin_box_jitter_plot(prism_data, "area_cholesterol", "Stool Cholesterol", "PRISM")

ismA_cholestenone_prism <- ismA_generate_violin_box_jitter_plot(prism_data, "area_cholestenone", "Stool Cholestenone", "PRISM")

wilcox.test(area_cholesterol ~ sir_Encoder, data = prism_data)

wilcox.test(area_cholestenone ~ sir_Encoder, data = prism_data)

wilcox.test(area_coprostanol ~ sir_Encoder, data = prism_data)


```

```{r disease_plot}
#playground
library(tidyr)
disease_summary_ismA <- processed %>%
  group_by(Diagnosis, ismA_Encoder) %>%
  summarise(Count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Diagnosis) %>%
  mutate(Percentage = (Count / sum(Count)) * 100)

disease_summary_sir <- processed %>%
  group_by(Diagnosis, sir_Encoder) %>%
  summarise(Count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Diagnosis) %>%
  mutate(Percentage = (Count / sum(Count)) * 100)


p1 <- ggplot(disease_summary_sir, aes(x = Diagnosis, y = Count, fill = sir_Encoder)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Encoder" = "#ff7f00", "Non-Encoder" = "gray")) +  # Custom colors
  labs(title = "ismA vs ecSIR and Conversion of Cholesterol",
       x = "Converter Status",
       xlabs = ("Detected, Undetected"),
       y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()

p2 <- ggplot(disease_summary_ismA, aes(x = Diagnosis, y = Count, fill = ismA_Encoder)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Encoder" = "#377eb8", "Non-Encoder" = "gray")) +  # Custom colors
  labs(
       x = "Coprostanol",
       xlabs = ("Detected, Undetected"),
       y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()

p1 + p2

```
